panel.kicker: The Gate of Trust · the pilgrim caravan
panel.title: Abbas the caravan master
panel.text: Abbas leads a caravan to Makkah every month, and the great Hajj caravan in Shawwal. “Your work is here,” he says. “But you could send someone who has dreamed of it all his life.”
panel.away: on the road · home in {n} days
panel.secret_label: Ask Abbas not to say who paid
panel.secret_locked: (You can give in secret once you have read the scholar's first page.)

pilgrims.name: Old Musa
pilgrims.line: Has weighed other men's goods for fifty years and never seen the Kaaba.
say_secret: Someone sent Old Musa on Umrah

pilgrims.name: Yunus the muezzin
pilgrims.line: Calls the adhan five times a day and dreams of hearing it in Makkah.

pilgrims.name: Jamal the boat master
pilgrims.line: Has carried pilgrims across the river every year and never gone himself.

pilgrims.name: Idris the imam
pilgrims.line: Has taught the rites of Hajj for forty years and never performed it.
